policy_note: The oracle evaluates evidence and comparability only. It does not estimate causal effects, certify compliance or measure real buildings. Experience evidence, meter readings and owner service receipts remain distinct.

semantics.scope: All observations, predictions and models must match scope, design/BOM revision, observation window and operating context.
semantics.evidence: Only current owner-bound observations with required calibration/coverage and evidence class are admitted.
semantics.static_gap: Raw observed minus original design prediction is reported only when unit, scope, revision and context match.
semantics.dynamic_gap: Reported only for calibrated models with independently validated, disjoint training/validation data and a declared applicability envelope.
semantics.service_floor: Evaluated separately from energy or cost; a pass on one metric cannot compensate for failure on another.
semantics.m_and_v: M&V eligibility is not an energy-savings result. Baseline and post periods, normalization variables, coverage and method identity are required.
semantics.causal: Causal eligibility is not a causal finding. Raw before/after comparisons do not establish attribution.
semantics.privacy: Experience claims require authorized consent and remain self-report, not technical measurements.
semantics.claim_ceiling: Synthetic evidence and comparability classification only.
